subject: [PATCH v9 04/32] powerpc: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds PMD swap-exclusive helpers for the powerpc architecture, which allows a PMD-mapped anonymous THP to be kept mapped across a swap round-trip. The helpers are implemented by wrapping the existing PTE ones and reusing the _PAGE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE flag. This is necessary because book3s64 builds a swap PMD by running the PTE encoding over pmd_pte().
